position_rules: Position numbers above are one-based. Bytes determine index within a half; positions determine half. Word33 encodes first byte SHA256(SHA256(seed)) and is even-half, not a passphrase.

external_secret.guidance: No derivation passphrase in this profile. Local wallet encryption password is distinct and is never stored.

semantic_distinction: 32-byte raw wallet seed plus one checksum byte. Never substitute BIP39 or Cake native15 even though all target Decred.
